verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a model lifecycle in which each Serverless API model moves through defined stages from release to retirement, so users can plan migrations before a model is retired. It also marks Labs models as experimental, a stability tier for choosing production models. API versioning shows up only in the /v1 path of the models endpoint. There is no evidence of an explicit API-version deprecation policy. Missing for 10: a documented API (not just model) versioning and deprecation policy, stated notice periods or timelines, a changelog or migration guarantees, and independent corroboration.
